settings.fold: dgssp.mitigation.fold_isa (= fold_transpiled) + rebase_to_backend, via plan_zne_batch; submitted as-is (no further transpilation)
settings.drift_check: scale-1 repeat, as the last PUBs, of the two smallest instances whose ideal P_sol exceeds P_uniform by >= 0.25

sampler.notes: No measurement mitigation: SamplerV2 has no readout-error mitigation option (resilience options exist only for EstimatorV2), and measurement twirling (twirling.enable_measure) is kept off so readout noise keeps the form the calibration-derived noise model assumes. rep_delay and init_qubits are left at the device defaults. Error suppression is gate twirling only: it is noise tailoring for ZNE (folded noise grows predictably once coherent errors are randomised). Dynamical decoupling is off by design: it is not part of C2, the noise model has no counterpart, and it would change each fold's idle noise differently. The local simulator path ignores twirling (qiskit-ibm-runtime warns); under the Aer noise model, which is already stochastic, twirling does not change the expected distribution.

estimate.floor_model: sum shots * (ASAP-scheduled duration + default rep_delay), execution only
estimate.verify: Measure per_shot and overhead from job.usage() of a previous small job (paper/hardware/usage.md once one exists), or from https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/docs/en/guides/estimate-job-run-time (quick rule there: 2 s + 0.00035 s per execution).

preflight.not_covered: plan entitlements and server-side option support (twirling, DD) are only checked when the job arrives
